ops.title: Origin-side claude↔daemon refresh double-spend: separate locks (claude .oauth_refresh.lock per-account vs cc-pool acct-NN.lock) let an in-session claude and the daemon both spend one single-use refresh token on the ORIGIN machine

ops.text: cc-pool and claude serialize OAuth refresh on the same account (shared lock or daemon-suppresses-while-session-live), so no same-machine double-spend → invalid_grant → tombstone

distinct from the cross-machine sync redesign (db150a6); that redesign's stripped peer blobs already eliminate the peer-side case, and full-credential CAS compare makes the daemon refuse to clobber claude's winning rotation — this task is the ORIGIN-only residual
